visualCharacteristics: Below 80% to cards-info (text-only tinted cards) and cards-insights (article cards with top photo, date, tag). These have large circular images above centered text and a filled pill CTA. | H2 left-aligned; 3 cards per row, each with a large circular image, centered text (H4 fund name, italic/bold tagline, bold summary, Objective, Investment Managers) and a filled blue pill "Learn more" button pinned to the bottom. On mobile the cards become a slider with prev/next arrows (.biography-item__arrow-container).

contentPattern.description: 3 fund cards: circular image, fund name, tagline, summary, objective, managers, Learn more CTA

cells: Image (image, imageAlt); empty cell kept for text-only cards

Text: H4 title; tagline/fund name as an emphasised paragraph (not a heading, empty
 
spacers dropped); bold summary paragraph; "Objective:" paragraph; "Investment Manager(s):" paragraph; trailing "Learn more" link paragraph as CTA
insightsCells: Text: date paragraph, read-time paragraph, H4 title linked to the article, author paragraph, tag paragraph ("Equities")

usage.description: Fund/people cards, 3 per row on desktop, one-per-view slider with prev/next arrows on mobile. One row per card: image (cropped to a circle) | H4 title, tagline, summary, Objective, Investment Manager(s) and a trailing link-only paragraph rendered as a pinned primary pill CTA. Empty spacer headings are removed.

reuseGuidance: Use for fund selections with round imagery. For text-only tinted cards use cards-info; for article listings use cards-insights.
